title: Breakfast Quesadillas
subtitle: Crisp flour tortillas packed with eggs, bacon, and pepper jack.
description: Flour tortillas stuffed with eggs, cheese, and peppers, griddled crisp and cut into wedges. Stack on a tray and serve with salsa and sour cream.

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.notes: and salsa verde at the line

steps.title: Prep the fillings
steps.instruction: Cook bacon until crisp, drain, and crumble. Soft-scramble eggs over medium-low heat—they should still look glossy. Drain pico well so quesadillas don't steam and split.

steps.title: Build on half the tortilla
steps.instruction: On one half of each tortilla, layer cheese, eggs, bacon, a spoon of pico, and more cheese. Fold over and press gently to compact without tearing.

steps.title: Griddle until golden
steps.instruction: Heat a large griddle or skillet over medium with butter. Cook quesadillas 3–4 minutes per side with a spatula press until deeply golden and cheese melts through.

steps.title: Hold and cut
steps.instruction: Transfer to a cutting board and rest 2 minutes so cheese sets. Cut each into 3 wedges with a sharp knife or pizza wheel. Hold warm on a sheet pan at 200°F.

steps.title: Serve with dips
steps.instruction: Serve wedges with sour cream and salsa verde at the line. Keep crispy wedges uncovered; cover only if holding longer than 15 minutes.

stationWorkflow: Griddle two quesadillas at a time while a second cook builds the next pair—never stack uncooked folds.
Use a flat press or second spatula to maximize crust contact; pale quesadillas mean cold centers.
Cut on a dedicated board and slide wedges directly into a warm hotel pan for self-serve.
cleanupNotes: Wipe the griddle between batches with a damp towel and tongs to prevent burnt cheese buildup.
Drain pico through a fine mesh strainer over a bowl—wet salsa is the number-one cause of soggy quesadillas.
leftovers: Reheat wedges in a dry skillet over medium-low with a lid until cheese remelts—microwave makes them rubbery.
Chop leftover wedges into a breakfast nacho topping with extra cheese and pickled jalapeños.
